name: brent-parent-intelligence-studio
description: Eidos Works website, Insights hub, and Eidos Snapshot product.

scripts.build: npm run playground:glass && node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs && npm run kit:build && npm run content:generate && npm run typecheck && vite build --outDir dist && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --emptyOutDir false && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.preview:cf: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.test:platform: node --import tsx --test scripts/test-platform.ts scripts/test-members.ts scripts/test-relay.ts scripts/test-relay-runtime.mjs scripts/test-inquiries.ts scripts/test-thread-form.mjs
scripts.test:playground: npm run playground:glass && node --import tsx --test scripts/test-playground.ts scripts/test-playground-cloud.ts scripts/test-spatial-composition.ts scripts/test-spatial-release.ts
scripts.test:spatial: npm run playground:glass && node --import tsx --test scripts/test-spatial-composition.ts scripts/test-spatial-release.ts
